Writer Eric Wargo joins Danny Jones to argue that dreams can show the future before it comes. The episode title says scientists have proved that dreams predict what lies ahead. Wargo studies time and the mind in his books.

Wargo shares cases in which a dream matched a later event in sharp detail. He argues the mind can reach back from what is to come, a quirk of how time works. Jones asks how chance and cherry-picking are ruled out. Listeners get a strange, well told case. The library holds the talk as an archive record of the guest's claims.
